newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Anglo buys stake in UK gaming firm.
newsitem.headline: Manila Anglo buys stake in UK gaming firm.

text.p: Anglo Philippine Holdings Corp said on Monday it had bought four million shares, or 2.0 percent, of Olympic Gold plc of the United Kingdom.
In a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange, the holding company said it signed the agreement last Friday by buying the shares at 25 pence each or a total of 500,000 pounds sterling.
Olympic Gold was incorporated in 1996 and seeks to undertake gaming and online lottery projects in eastern European states.
Olympic Gold is expected to be listed in London very soon, the statement said.
Anglo Philippines has interests in real estate and construction ventures including the mass transit railway system and oil exploration.
